name: Article count per journal
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(j:Journal) RETURN j.title, count(a) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

name: Top MeSH by article count
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]->(m:MeSHTerm) RETURN m.name, count(a) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

name: Top chemicals mentioned
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]->(c:Chemical) RETURN c.name, count(a) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

name: Most-cited articles
cypher: MATCH (a:Article)<-[:CITES]-(b:Article) RETURN a.pmid, count(b) AS cites ORDER BY cites DESC LIMIT 10

name: Most prolific authors
cypher: MATCH (au:Author)<-[:AUTHORED_BY]-(a:Article) RETURN au.name, count(a) AS n ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
